The DT7 seed loops give two outside transpositions generating S3 while preserving both marked transpositions.
A complete marked T3-DT-DT degree7 move graph has196literal states and784signed edges; every Schreier edge-loop transport lies in regularV4.
Two pure degree7 loops, one cubed to remove its marked3cycle action, generateV4 with the marked support fixed.
Three explicit pure degree9 mixed loops generate360outside permutations, givingA6 and fixing the marked support pointwise.
The commuting appended-DT loop has transport exactlyeta; conjugating old transpositions or3cycles byeta attaches both new sheets and proves maximality uniformly.
The full same-interface groups give the ordered-choice orbit counts by unused-letter parity correction or regularity.
